faction_leader.semantics: CFactionLeaderLink requires a Faction scope, resolves the complete faction identity through storage 0x570C768, requires CFaction+0x10 to round-trip, then projects CFaction+0x44 as a Character scope identity. The private reader must additionally resolve that ID through Character storage 0x570C130 and require CCharacter+0x18 to round-trip.
faction_leader.nullable_boundary: The exact null sentinel remains unclaimed. If CFaction+0x44 does not resolve while the enclosing faction and member-vector double sample remain stable, expose canonical leader as a nullable component and distinguish the legal no-leader state from a memory-read failure; do not substitute special CharacterID +0x90.
faction_leader.legal_empty_semantics: Stock faction definitions make requires_leader an independent opt-in whose default is no, and populist_faction permits county-only existence with requires_character=no. An unresolved canonical leader is therefore a legal nullable component and must not invalidate an otherwise stable faction/member row. Read failure and legal no-leader remain distinct statuses.
faction_leader.canonical_vs_portrait: The stock faction window portrait uses GetSpecialCharacterOrLeader, which may read CFaction+0x90 instead of canonical leader +0x44. The portrait is presentation data and cannot replace the canonical leader field.

character_member_vector.ownership: The GUI callback passes the address of the CFaction-embedded CPdxArray into a data-model wrapper. It does not copy the array. The source is a borrowed view owned by the resolved faction and no process address may survive the synchronous capture.
character_member_vector.known_layout_limit: Only row vtable +0x00, member CharacterID +0x08, owner FactionID +0x0C, and the 0x20 stride are source-confirmed. Row +0x10..+0x1F remains opaque; no process-local vtable or opaque bytes may be published.
character_member_vector.owner_invariant: Each written CFactionCharacterMember row stores its enclosing CFaction+0x10 full-generation identity at row+0x0C. The private reader must require row.owner_faction_id == the targeting-row faction_id.

count_names.targeting_faction_count: outer FactionsWindow rows targeting the admitted player
count_names.total_member_count: CFaction+0x54 character count plus CFaction+0x6C county count; display-only unless separately requested

per_faction_requirements: reuse the already admitted full-generation faction_id and target CharacterID
resolve the same CFaction and require CFaction+0x10 to equal faction_id
copy leader ID and the complete member data/count/ID/owner sequence twice under two equal admissions
require non-negative stable count, positive-count/non-null-data, a bounded count, and overflow-safe count*0x20 addressing
resolve every retained leader/member ID through Character storage and require CCharacter+0x18 round-trip
require every row+0x0C owner FactionID to equal the enclosing targeting-row faction_id
require member CharacterIDs to be unique within the faction while preserving the source fact that leader membership is unknown
publish only owned IDs and counts; never publish a borrowed address, vtable, or opaque row bytes
same_admission_reader_contract.zero_semantics: A valid signed count of zero yields an empty owned member list. It is distinct from a read or identity failure.
same_admission_reader_contract.leader_membership_relation: Stock independence/liberty/claimant demand scripts explicitly exclude faction_leader while iterating every_faction_member, so those script iterators include the leader. Cross-type equality with the GUI +0x48 vector remains unproven; compute leader_present_in_character_members only from same-admission IDs and never require or deduplicate it globally.
same_admission_reader_contract.failure_publication: Any faction, leader, vector stability, bounds, or member identity failure retains the previous complete private generation.

evidence_limit: This package freezes exact static source semantics only. It does not implement the private feasibility reader, does not provide a paused live capture, and does not close faction type, war, power/discontent, dangerous predicate, gift preview/action, or any public MCP/schema readiness.
